description: This file defines the FavoritesController class in a C# ASP.NET Core web API project. The controller handles HTTP requests related to favoriting and unfavoriting articles identified by a slug, utilizing MediatR for mediating commands.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC Controller for managing article favorites. Implements endpoints to add or remove an article as favorite, secured with JWT authentication.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST request to add an article to favorites based on its slug.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an article from favorites based on its slug.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Invokes mediator to process add favorite command.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Invokes mediator to process delete favorite command.
